news.title: UNI President Mark Nook to retire at conclusion of current academic year
news.summary_en: Mark Nook will continue to serve until the 12th president of the University of Northern Iowa begins their service.

news.title: “Can’t wait to see where you go:” A father’s voicemail anchors new UNI commercial
news.summary_en: Those words close a father’s voicemail to his college-aged student in the University of Northern Iowa’s new 30-second commercial, which will begin airing soon on Iowa television stations and streaming platforms such as Hulu and YouTube.
